text: My name's not Samuel Pike.
I can tell you nothing, sir.

Captain.

Yes, you're the type of man

Oh, boy, you, I.

Talk away?

I think it would only be fair

Never fear.

A share?
Yes, indeed, yes.

Aye, well.

Mm.

Tom!

Tom!

Quick!

Innkeeper.

Enter.

Business?
Aye.

Aye.
Brandy, silks, perhaps?

Master innkeeper.
I keep a law-abiding ship here.

Heaven preserve us.

Trust, aye, if there's smuggling to be done.

Maybe.

Longfoot? The churchwarden?

Captain Pike.
Jamaica!

Oh.
